title: MCS Fixes (X)
description: This datapack fixes bugs and resolves illogical vanilla things. All settings are controlled by gamerules!
body:
[No longer supports updates!]
===

This datapack fixes bugs and resolves illogical vanilla things. All settings are controlled by gamerules!

Features:

1. Slab X-Ray fix, you will get blindness and damage.
2. Infinite carpet fix (You have to mine carpets with shears).
3. Nether roof void damage (128 block higher in nether you will take 4 damage per second). 
4. Mobs jump over the rails.
5. Aggressive mobs can destroy boats and minecart, if they are targeted at entity.
6. Boats and Minecarts destroy when they fall from more than 24 blocks height.

Read more information here: https://www.planetminecraft.com/data-pack/glitch-fixer-v1-0-datapack/
